edges.label: sworn witness
edges.note: Nuccetelli described 2003-2005 incursions at Vandenberg AFB during NRO launches and asserted each was documented and reported up the chain.

edges.label: Military police witness and report recipient at Vandenberg, 2003-2005
edges.note: Nuccetelli testified to reports of a glowing red square over two missile defense sites on 14 October 2003 and a triangular craft over the main base in 2005.

edges.label: Nuccetelli served in security forces at Vandenberg 2003-2005
edges.note: His sworn written testimony of 9 September 2025 describes the 14 October 2003 red square over two missile defense sites, a rectangular craft larger than a football field, a threatened witness, and a 2005 triangular craft.

edges.label: Nuccetelli says the Air Force records are now held by AARO and the FBI
edges.note: 'Official Air Force records documenting it are now held by AARO and the FBI.' A specific, FOIA-targetable custody claim that neither agency has confirmed or denied.

edges.label: The Vandenberg incidents entered the congressional record in September 2025
edges.note: Nuccetelli named AARO and the FBI as custodians of the official Air Force records for specific dated incidents at a named installation - a checkable custody claim Congress has not pursued to production.
